name: JHEMR↔HIS 离院方式分布对账

sides.sql: SELECT DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION AS CODE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(:START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE(:END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION

SELECT discharge_disposition AS CODE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM report.r_pat_visit WHERE discharge_date_time >= CAST(:START_DATE AS date) AND discharge_date_time < CAST(:END_DATE AS date) AND discharge_disposition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY discharge_disposition
